headline: Nigeria Cocoa Exports to United States Surge
summary: Nigeria’s cocoa bean exports to the United States rose significantly from $21.7 million in 2024 to $142 million in 2025, according to the US mission in Nigeria.
why: Agricultural export growth statistics highlight shifting trade balances and supply trends in soft commodities for international markets.

impacts.name: Nigeria
impacts.why: Surging agricultural export statistics highlight favorable trade balances and soft commodity supply trends.
